results.claim: Descended trace norm |tr(A) - tr(B)| is well-defined on M_2/ker(tr) and satisfies (tr A)^2 <= 2 ||A||_F^2 with equality iff A = (tr A / 2) I_2
Central channel projection P_Z(A) = (tr A / 2) I_2 is idempotent, central, and Frobenius-orthogonal to the traceless complement A - P_Z(A)
Split-pair product skein chirality z^2 w(K1) w(K2) is invariant under simultaneous mirror while total writhe z(w(K1)+w(K2)) and single-factor mirror negate
Genus-3 handlebody linking matrix quadratic form and writhe-linking asymmetry negate under mirror inversion and satisfy exact trace-off-diagonal decomposition
At the order-4 fixed point 2x^2 - 1 = 0, first and second volume perturbations vanish and the three-term recurrence gives U_2(x)=1, U_3(x)=0, U_4(x)=-1
